name: Harlan Tetch
source_profile:
Harlan Tetch (CG) — Mining Foreman and Labor Advocate

Harlan is an experienced miner who has worked in the Blackvein foothills for more than a decade. Having survived several serious accidents and witnessed numerous preventable deaths, he has become an outspoken advocate for improved working conditions, fair wages, and compensation for injured laborers.

He maintains close relationships with many of the town's independent miners and has helped organize an informal mutual-aid association that provides assistance to injured workers and their families. His efforts have brought him into contact with Rikket Nails, the Cinderhook labor advocate, with whom he shares considerable sympathy despite occasional disagreements over wages and competition between goblin and human workers.

Harlan is generally respected by Sheriff Lorne, who appreciates his efforts to resolve labor disputes peacefully. Orson Blythe, however, considers his public meetings a potential source of unrest, particularly when they interfere with mining operations.

Harlan regards Bennet Pike and the Crowbar Company with particular suspicion. He distrusts the willingness of desperate mine owners to employ outlaw engineers for dangerous blasting work, and has repeatedly warned that the pursuit of greater profits will eventually produce a catastrophe.
